name: Yelkenli
scene: A sailboat with two sweeping sails crosses a sunny blue sea beneath a radiant sun.
notes: Design sheet only. Gold/coral boat and blue/turquoise background preserve distinct colour pairs; white sails in the source scene were replaced to comply with the no-white-glass brief. Inspected both generations; used the single permitted regeneration to open the gaps beneath the sails and reduce background complexity. Remaining doubts: subtle tonal variation persists despite flat-fill instructions; some turquoise sun neighbours share its colour and may merge during tracing; the right sail foot approaches the hull closely and needs contact review. No obvious loose line ends or X crossings seen at sheet scale. Pane count and geometry are not yet tracer-validated.
prompt:
Create a flat stained-glass puzzle DESIGN SHEET, NOT finished textured glass. Portrait 3:4 canvas. Reference images show the elegant leaded composition style only; create a NEW SAILBOAT subject. A graceful oval panel nearly fills pure white canvas, fully closed thick black rim. Exactly 32–42 large closed panes, aim 36 total. A recognisable elegant sailing yacht with TWO sweeping triangular sails, curved hull, a round sun behind in the upper right, blue sea below and flowing sky bands. No childish geometry. Exactly FOUR flat saturated interior colours: golden yellow #E9B82F and coral red #D95843 used EXCLUSIVELY for the boat (both sails and hull); deep ocean blue #185B83 and turquoise #249DA6 EXCLUSIVELY for all background including sun, sky and sea. NO white or cream inside the panel. Alternate gold/coral in broad full-width sail strips; separate the two sails by a generous blue background gap so strips cannot form X junctions at the mast. Do not draw thin mast sliver panes or rigging. Hull has 3 broad alternating pieces. Make the sun turquoise surrounded by blue; solar rays and sky bands alternate blue/turquoise. Sea consists of long elegant broad curved bands alternating blue/turquoise. All lead pure black uniform width approx 1% canvas width; smooth curves. All lines terminate on rim or other lines; no loose ends, no X or four-way junctions. Space T junctions at least 3% panel width. No tiny cells, no thin slivers or almost-touching lines. No border framing band. Strict flat solid fills with NO shading, gradient, texture, highlights, letters, signature or decoration. References guide style only, NOT their complexity or extra hues. Render clean traceable bitmap at 1536x2048 if possible.
CORRECTION PASS: The previous attempt had unwanted gradients and narrow water wedges between sails and hull. Fix these specifically. EVERY pane must have a mathematically uniform solid fill, like a flat vector flood-fill, without even subtle lighting. Use EXACT RGB palette above. Position the sail bases a full 7% of panel height ABOVE the hull so the blue background there forms a broad generous continuous open water/sky region, never thin wedges. The two sail tips must terminate within sky, never coincide with a sky divider; keep all sky dividers at least 4% panel width away from sail tips. Make sail separation at least 5% panel width. Use 34–40 total panes. Simplify sun rays to 4 broad areas; sun in turquoise touching only blue regions, no turquoise ray touching sun. Remove excess subdivisions to avoid slivers. Maintain elegant smooth oval and sailing scene. Absolute flat vector colours are critical. Style reference gradients must NOT be copied.
